snippet.title: CJP Tiranga March के बीच धरी रह गई Delhi Police की तैयारी, Abhijeet Dipke-Neha Bora के साथ क्या हुआ?
snippet.description:
The political battle over protests in Delhi deepened on October 16, as the city turned into a fortress once again. Minutes before the “Lehra Do Tiranga” march called by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and AISA, its founder Abhijeet Dipke was detained and stopped from reaching Connaught Place, even as over 25,000 personnel were deployed, new CCTV cameras installed and Section 163 enforced. What followed was a day-long game of cat and mouse across central Delhi, flash protests and rallies by demonstrators, detentions by the police, including of AISA president Neha Bora. The report also traces the “regime change” narrative around Bangladesh, now officially raised by the BJP, with Defence Minister Rajnath Singh’s remarks and the responses from the Congress and AAP. At the Supreme Court, three key matters played out: a traders’ plea over mounting losses at Connaught Place, the case admitted against Rahul Gandhi over an alleged shoving incident, and contempt notices issued to Sanjay Raut and Nikhil Wagle. In the headlines: Uttarakhand minister Rekha Arya’s FIR against her husband, a CERT-In disclosure on rogue AI agents, the induction of INS Samarthak, JD(U) MLA Anant Singh’s “nine murders” remark, and Mallikarjun Kharge’s letter to PM Modi on delimitation.

Watch The Indian Express Hindi roundup with Saurabh Dwivedi.

İstanbul'un varoşlarında geçen filmde, mahallenin genç ve yakışıklı genci ve aynı zamanda mahalle muhtarının oğlu olan Kemal (Bulut Aras) minibüsçülük yapmaktadır.
